insights.title: Forecast ↓ — Expect App Total Revenue to soften next period — App Total New Subs -17.7%, led by YCP.
insights.body: App Total New Subs -17.7% runs well below its upstream (App Total New User -7.5%, App Total Install +2.7%; Δ -15.3pp). With the 7-day trial lag, expect App Total Revenue to soften next period. The drag is concentrated in YCP (-24.8%); YMK is -12.5%.

insights.title: Lead–lag check — App Total Revenue's -0.3% isn't from acquisition — check churn / pricing / refunds.
insights.body: App Total Revenue 07-27 vs 07-20 = -0.3% runs counter to its 7-day driver App Total New Subs 07-20 vs 07-13 = +0.4% — App Total Revenue's move isn't explained by the prior subs cohort; look at churn, refunds, or pricing rather than acquisition.

insights.title: Funnel conversion — Conversion to New Subs splits by app — YMK softening (-12.5% vs upstream -1.5%).
insights.body: Upstream→New Subs conversion splits by app: YMK -12.5% vs upstream -1.5% (conversion softening); YCP -24.8% vs upstream -3.5% (conversion softening). (Revenue is downstream and lags ~7d — see the lead–lag check.)

insights.title: App split — App Total New User -7.5% concentrated in YMK — not platform-wide.
insights.body: App Total New User -7.5% is uneven by app (All App -7.5%, YMK -8.8%, YCP -7.4%, YCV -0.1%) — driven mainly by YMK, not a platform-wide shift.

insights.title: Country outlier — JP is the outlier on App Total Revenue (+22.9% vs -0.6%).
insights.body: App Total Revenue · All App: JP +22.9% vs all-country -0.6% (Δ +23.5pp; ≈6% of revenue).

insights.title: Data gap — 13 slice(s) missing data — excluded from analysis.
insights.body: 13 slice(s) n/a (missing data): YAT·CA·App Total New Subs, YAT·CA·App Total Revenue, YAT·ES·App Total New Subs, YAT·ES·App Total Revenue ….
